ns2:section.sectionText: This course is initially restricted to students already in the Actuarial Science major, but the restriction will be removed during business hours on April 22, 2022 for students interested in transferring and others. Students interested in a transfer to actuarial science should see the On-campus transfer information at go.illinois.edu/actsci. Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section beginning with the same letter in Fall and Spring terms.
